title: Let editors manage webhooks
body:
Editors set up most integrations but had to ask an admin every time they needed a webhook.

- Replaces the hard-coded admin check with a role ranking (`viewer < editor < admin < owner`) and a `requireRole(member, minimum)` helper; `requireAdmin` is now `requireRole(member, "admin")`.
- Editors can list and create webhooks. Deleting stays admin-only.
- Creating a webhook now validates the URL (https only) and drops unknown event names.

Deliveries already go through the egress proxy, which refuses private and link-local addresses.
